content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Newport News

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and verifiable project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour requirements for your educational background, then document your project leadership experience. Granite PM Academy's advisors can clarify eligibility criteria and help you prepare your application materials before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp—an instructor-led course delivered entirely online, designed for working professionals in Newport News. Attend sessions on your schedule, interact with active certified practitioners in real time, and receive materials aligned to PMI's current exam content outline.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the 35-hour course, file your PMP application directly with PMI, including proof of your formal education and project experience hours. Pay the associated exam fee and await PMI's audit decision. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on documentation and application submission throughout this process.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the PMP Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and final review sessions—to reinforce key concepts and test-taking strategy. Schedule your exam when you feel confident, then sit for the computer-based PMP exam at an authorized Pearson VUE testing center.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP credential is valid for three years. During your renewal cycle, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through approved learning activities, project work, and volunteering. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU-eligible courses and resources to help you stay current and renew your certification.
